name: Disable CPU Core Parking
description: Disables CPU core parking to keep more processor cores active, which can improve responsiveness and provide more consistent performance under load.

description_i18n.en: Disables CPU core parking to keep more processor cores active, which can improve responsiveness and provide more consistent performance under load.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert das Parkieren von Prozessorkernen, um mehr Kerne aktiv zu halten und die Reaktionsfähigkeit sowie Leistung unter Last zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le stationnement des cœurs de processeur pour maintenir plus de cœurs actifs et améliorer la réactivité ainsi que les performances sous charge.

warnings.title: Power behavior change
warnings.message: Power behavior may change, which can affect battery life, heat, or fan noise

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the processor power settings in Windows by adjusting the minimum number of active processors via registry values or Powercfg commands
